in_marathi.name: Arunima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arunima हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arunima is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'aruni', meaning 'red'. The suffix 'ma' denotes 'mother'. The name represents the red lotus, which is a sacred flower in Hinduism and symbolizes purity, detachment, and enlightenment.
